correctness.rationale: Every intersecting edge family with at least four 2-subsets is a unique star (otherwise only triangle). For n>=6 optimum ordered layer pair is full star at i and opposite partial star at j avoiding ij, count 2n(n-1), and one legal move swaps orientation of pair (i,j), forming n(n-1) disjoint edges. At n=5 three-set triangle exception yields 80 states and connected graph (140 edges, degrees 3/4, diameter9); n=3 gives Q3 and n=4 gives 8 isolates. Read RESULT.md and prism_direct.py; independently generated all bitmask maximum stable sets for n=3,4,5, checked counts, graph metrics and all-pairs BFS diameter9. Maximal-independent-set domination forces any jump to be a slide.
